SKU is the nation’s leading accelerator built exclusively for early-stage consumer product brands. For 15 years, we’ve helped consumer packaged goods founders go from scrappy operators to confident CEOs. Every fall and spring, 7-8 companies experience first-in-class, operator-led curriculum, pitch practice, and hands-on mentorship from CPG industry experts. By the end of 12 weeks, these brands are set up for scale and fundraising. What does “SKU” stand for? In CPG, a SKU (pronounced “skew”) is a Stock Keeping Unit, the barcode on every product on the shelf. Every great brand starts with one. We’re here to help you build the next one shoppers can’t live without. Who is SKU for? Brands that are in-market, have real traction, and are hungry for what’s next.
